effect.name: Segmented Liquid-Crystal Display (Switch)
effect.description: The shader simulates the effect of a segmented liquid crystal display.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Segmented Liquid-Crystal Display (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.25 */
parameter.description: The shader simulates the effect of a segmented liquid crystal display.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: _Threshold
parameter.description: This variable determines the intersection of luminance where a lighter color should be visible and where a darker color should be visible..

parameter.name: Color Light
parameter.description: Determines what color should be used when brightness is at its highest.

parameter.name: Color Shadow
parameter.description: Determines what color should be used when lightness is at its lowest.
